instruction: Candid documentary photograph of a bright, minimalist indoor dance studio with large windows. On the left, the blonde girl (R5) in a beige long-sleeve top, shorts, and white socks stands with arms extended to the sides. On the right, the dark-haired young woman (R4) in a matching beige outfit and white socks bends her torso deeply to the left, her left arm arching over her head to hold hands with the blonde girl. Both look forward. Bright, soft, diffused natural light from the windows illuminates the clean, neutral space.

R5 remains upright with arms extended while R4 is the partner bending toward her
